subject: Eval grant whitelist approval for MedSys RFP
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@medsys.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: procureops@medsys.com
Date: 2028-07-26T13:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evaluation grant & short extension for MedSys RFP

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising. We're running an RFP bake-off next month and would like to include Redwood in an apples-to-apples comparison with two other vendors. The evaluation window is short (2 weeks) and procurement is asking for a small "whitelist" allocation up front so we can run scale tests without committing to a contract this week.

What we're asking:
- 75k token eval credit to run end-to-end pipelines (ingest -> generation -> reranking)
- One 2-week trial extension beyond the standard sandbox window (to align with our benchmark dates)
- A short approval note we can show procurement that this request has been pre-approved by Redwood sales/ops (simple yes/no with conditions)

Attached is the SOW and a sample scoring rubric. Procurement has a few constraints around usage visibility and benchmark publication (they prefer results stay internal until vendor selection). If you need a PO or SOW countersigned to enable the credits, let me know and I can loop in our procurement contact (ProcureOps).

Appreciate any quick guidance — our internal timeline is tight (benchmarks start 08/08).

Best,
Alyssa Greene
Director, ML Platforms
MedSys Diagnostics

[Attachment: MedSys_RFP_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@medsys.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-26T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation grant & short extension for MedSys RFP

Alyssa — thanks for the details and the SOW. I can fast-track this but I need a quick internal sign-off on the amount and any redline on publication rights.

Internal next steps:
- I'll ask sales ops and Ben for approval on a 75k token-equivalent grant and 2-week extension.
- We typically require a non-public benchmark clause for trial grants in competitive bake-offs; is procurement OK with that? If not, we can add time-limited embargo language.

Ben/Neha — tagging you for approval. If you're comfortable, I'll send Alyssa the formal note and enable the quota.

Thanks,
Kim
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-27T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation grant & short extension for MedSys RFP

Kim/Neha — pre-approve 75k token eval credit and a 2-week trial extension for MedSys (RDW-2028-MEDSYS-059) with the following conditions:

- Credit cap: 75,000 tokens total; any overage will require PO/paid top-up.
- Non-public benchmark clause: results may not be published externally for 90 days post-selection without Redwood written consent.
- One-time special: no additional credits without renewed approval.

Please note: Finance wants procurement to sign the standard procurement-term-sheet (attached) that includes usage telemetry sharing for billing accuracy. If procurement won't sign telemetry, we need written acknowledgement of that limitation.

Assignee: Kimberly to confirm with Alyssa and enable quota once we get the signed term sheet or explicit procurement ACK.

Ben
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: procurement-term-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-27T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation grant & short extension for MedSys RFP

Agree with Ben. Two quick clarifications I want in the approval note to procurement:
1) Scope: The credit is for non-production evaluation only (no data residency or HIPAA-bound workflows; if they need that we route to Private deployment).
2) Duration: the extension is 2 additional weeks from the standard sandbox end date, not open-ended.

If procurement confirms the non-public clause and scope, we can provide the approval note and enable the quota.

—Neha
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@medsys.com>
Date: 2028-07-28T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation grant & short extension for MedSys RFP

Alyssa — copying in Kim/Neha. Per internal review we can approve the 75k token eval grant and 2-week sandbox extension under the conditions below. This is a one-off allowance tied to RDW-2028-MEDSYS-059.

Conditions (final):
- Grant: 75,000 token-eq eval credit.
- Extension: 2 weeks beyond the standard sandbox window (benchmarks to complete by 2028-08-22).
- Publication: Results are embargoed for 90 days after selection.
- Scope: Evaluation only; not for protected health info or regulated production workloads.
- Procurement: Please review and sign the attached term sheet or acknowledge telemetry opt-out in writing.

Once procurement signs (or ACKs telemetry opt-out), Kim will enable the account quota and share the DocuSign link for the one-page grant confirmation.

Ben
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
